caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved garment resembling a coat or robe, displayed flat against a plain, light-colored background. The coat is primarily blue with a white and light yellow plaid pattern. It features vertical and horizontal lines forming rectangular shapes throughout the fabric. The coat has a high collar, a front opening with visible buttons, and elaborate trim along the edges, cuffs, collar, front, and hem, done in a zigzag and dotted pattern with darker and lighter shades that contrast the plaid. There is a decorative belt or sash tied at the waist, patterned with similar colors and motifs as the trim. The drawing is detailed and neatly rendered, with visible brushstrokes and shading to suggest the texture and folds of the fabric. In the lower right corner, there is a signature.
title: Child's Dress
